title: Multiplicative cosimplicial Godement models
statement: For every scheme $X$ and module sheaves $F,G$, there exist cosimplicial objects $A,B,C$, augmentations $a:F[0]\to K(A)$, $b:G[0]\to K(B)$, $c:(F\otimes G)[0]\to K(C)$, and a pointwise tensor morphism $\mu:A\otimes B\to C$. Each augmented object satisfies the concrete term, coface and germ-unit predicate ModuleCupGodementModel, and the degree-zero pairing takes tensor products of augmented sections to the augmentation of their tensor product. Here $K$ is the alternating coface complex extended by zero. No quasi-isomorphism or flasqueness is asserted.

source.place: Godement resolution; Lemma 20.30.1 (0FKS); monad multiplication and tensor compatibility: Banerjee, arXiv:1004.1491, section 1.1.4, pp. 15--16.

proof.text: Apply moduleCup_godement_models_exist separately to F, G and F tensor G. Obtain three augmented Godement models, each also with the concrete monad codegeneracies.
Apply moduleCup_godement_pairing_for_models to the three models and their codegeneracy witnesses. This gives a cosimplicial multiplication and the degree-zero morphism equality over a tensor b and c.

Evaluate that morphism equality on an open V and the tensor section x tensor y. Composition of module morphisms evaluates as composition of section maps, and tensorHom_app_tmulSection rewrites the first map as the tensor of the two augmented sections. This is exactly the requested degree-zero section equality. Assemble all existential witnesses and the original model predicates.

lean.statement:
theorem moduleCup_godement_model_pairing (X : Scheme.{u}) (F G : X.Modules) :
    ∃ (A B C : CosimplicialObject X.Modules)
      (a : (CochainComplex.singleFunctor X.Modules 0).obj F ⟶
        (((alternatingCofaceMapComplex X.Modules).obj A).extend
          ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat))
      (b : (CochainComplex.singleFunctor X.Modules 0).obj G ⟶
        (((alternatingCofaceMapComplex X.Modules).obj B).extend
          ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat))
      (c : (CochainComplex.singleFunctor X.Modules 0).obj (F ⊗ G) ⟶
        (((alternatingCofaceMapComplex X.Modules).obj C).extend
          ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat))
      (μ : CategoryTheory.Monoidal.FunctorCategory.tensorObj
        (C := SimplexCategory) (D := X.Modules) A B ⟶ C),
      ModuleCupGodementModel X F A a ∧ ModuleCupGodementModel X G B b ∧
      ModuleCupGodementModel X (F ⊗ G) C c ∧
      ∀ (V : X.Opens)
        (x : Γ(((CochainComplex.singleFunctor X.Modules 0).obj F).X 0, V))
        (y : Γ(((CochainComplex.singleFunctor X.Modules 0).obj G).X 0, V)),
        (((((alternatingCofaceMapComplex X.Modules).obj A).extendXIso
          ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat (i := 0) rfl).hom ⊗ₘ
          (((alternatingCofaceMapComplex X.Modules).obj B).extendXIso
          ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat (i := 0) rfl).hom) ≫ μ.app ⦋0⦌ ≫
          (((alternatingCofaceMapComplex X.Modules).obj C).extendXIso
          ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat (i := 0) rfl).inv).val.app (op V)
          (tmulSection ((a.f 0).val.app (op V) x) ((b.f 0).val.app (op V) y)) =
        (c.f 0).val.app (op V) (tmulSection x y)
